questions: Do you have any chest pain or pressure, and if so when did it start?
Have you noticed any swelling or pain in one leg, especially the calf (or recent immobility/travel/surgery)?
answers: Yes. I have pain. It started at a pace of 6 (0-10), and it’s a sharp, knife stroke–type pain, increased when I breathe in deeply. The pain is in my right and left side of the chest and radiates to my right and left scapula and the posterior chest wall (right side). I also have shortness of breath or difficulty breathing in a significant way.

Yes. I have swelling in one or more areas of my body, specifically the posterior aspect of the ankle (right) and posterior aspect of the ankle (left). I’ve also had surgery within the last month and I have traveled out of the country to North America in the last 4 weeks.
